name: forget-me-not
source:
Waking up in a beautiful garden filled with blue flowers, with only vague memories, you meet a mysterious young man who seems to know more than you do. But why does it all feel so familiar…?

[From [url=https://zerotosiki.itch.io/forget-me-not]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在一个开满蓝色花朵的美丽花园中醒来，只有模糊的记忆，你遇到了一位神秘的年轻人，他似乎比你懂得更多。但为什么这一切感觉如此熟悉……？

[来自[url=https://zerotosiki.itch.io/forget-me-not]itch.io[/url]]
